findings.detail: The single-GPU launch branch indexes _LAUNCHER['single_visible_dev'], but the active _LAUNCHER dict at lines 124-131 does not define that key. On a one-GPU host with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES unset, the real trainer entry point crashes with KeyError before spawning the training process. The older, shadowed launcher dict at lines 105-112 also lacks the key.
findings.reproduction: Run the entry point with no RANK, one visible CUDA device (or force GENREC_SINGLE_GPU=1), and unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. resolve_single_gpu() is true and line 483 raises KeyError: 'single_visible_dev'.
findings.correction: Define single_visible_dev in the active _LAUNCHER configuration (or avoid this missing-key lookup and inherit the current device visibility safely); exercise the actual launcher branch.

findings.detail: The trainer hard-codes inputs and outputs under /home/wlia0047/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec, while this checked-out repository and issue tree are under /fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec. Although the former input files happen to exist in this environment, a run writes the exported SID/checkpoint/metrics to the other checkout's shared baseline stage2 paths, not to this candidate tree. That makes the candidate output non-isolated and can overwrite baseline artifacts; this integration does not establish the intended frozen data/output path for this tree.
findings.reproduction: Invoke this candidate trainer and inspect OUTPUT_SID: it resolves to /home/wlia0047/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_RQ-VAE/sids_for_hgrec.npy, not a path under results/research/issue120/trees/round_20261025_021934_521/train_only_demand_signature. The source path also bypasses the active checkout's root resolution.
findings.correction: Resolve the frozen stage0 train parquet and embedding input relative to the canonical repository root (or explicit frozen-path constants), and direct all candidate SID/checkpoint/metrics outputs into this candidate's isolated output directory. Preserve the verified item-ID-to-embedding-row indexing when exporting.
